title: Working with AI Without Overload
look: Relay board: Flat assistant nodes on a grid, task cards gliding along live wires. Plain. Colors and type from the Zen-Sumi design system: washi paper, sumi ink, rationed vermillion.

scenes.name: The flood
scenes.desc: Code, analysis and answers pour onto the board faster than anyone can read them.

scenes.name: The questions
scenes.desc: Three questions: how to skim, whether to read for intent, how to know it is right.

scenes.name: Define first
scenes.desc: The cycle begins: concept, detailed requirements, and how it will be verified.

scenes.name: Design, plan, results
scenes.desc: Design with UX and mock-ups alongside, a phased plan with checks, then results.

scenes.name: Read less, check more
scenes.desc: Output passes through the verification frame; only what misses is surfaced for reading.
